assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was performed
CPT code 93229 was used for the Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias that may contribute to hemodynamic instability or embolic risk
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
The claim cannot be processed for payment at this time
The patient has the right to appeal this determination
